messages:
Zoey Wang: Quick design check — I noticed the new mini-row for function defs in the playground is helpful but opening the schema preview still shifts the run history. During quick debugging I lose my place. Anyone else?

Caleb Ortiz: Yup saw that. The micro-row idea is great, but the expansion causes layout shift. Could we expand into an anchored overlay (only over the schema column) so the history stays fixed?

Maya Singh: Overlay would preserve scroll, but overlays can break keyboard copy/paste flows. Alternative: expand an absolute-positioned panel that overlays the schema area without reflowing the rest of the page. Similar to a popover anchored to the row.

Rui Park: Copy nit: we have a few labels floating around — "Schema (auto-detect)", "Inferred schema", etc. Suggest standardizing to: "Schema preview — inferred" and when inference fails show: "Schema couldn't be inferred. Edit to continue."

Zoey Wang: Good call on copy. Accessibility: screen readers currently only announce "expanded". We should add a verbose aria-label, e.g. aria-label="Schema preview for function CreateSummary (expanded)" and use a polite aria-live region for the state change. Also preview-expand should not steal focus; only edit-expand should move focus to the first editable input.

A11yBot: Filed issue #901: "playground-minirow-a11y". Acceptance criteria: 1) expand control has verbose aria-label 2) preview expand leaves focus 3) edit expand focuses primary input 4) aria-live polite announcement.

Caleb Ortiz: Run history scan perf: can we add tiny param-type chips in the run rows? E.g. [TXT] [NUM] [FILE] — 1214px, icon + 2-4 char label. They'd make scanning faster.

Maya Singh: I like chips but ensure they're semantic with aria-labels like "title: text" and keyboard-focusable when tabbing through a run entry. Also ensure color contrast meets AA.

Rui Park: Dev note: if we collapse results by default we must not evict the KV cache needed for replay. I'll open a runtime ticket to confirm retention semantics.

Zoey Wang: Keybinding consistency: bind `R` to Run in playground (and show tooltip "Press R to run"). Also unify the action verb across UI to "Run" instead of Invoke/Execute/Start.

Caleb Ortiz: Animation guidance: preview-expand should be subtle (fade + scale) so it feels light; edit-expand should be immediate so screen readers and keyboard users have predictable focus. We'll add motion-reduced alternatives.

Maya Singh: UX poll: default collapsed (power users) or expanded (new users)? Reply with :one: collapse, :two: expand.

Rui Park: :one: (collapse)

Zoey Wang: :one: (collapse, with first-run auto-expand)

Caleb Ortiz: :one: (collapse)

A11yBot: Poll recorded: 3 votes collapse. Recommendation: default collapsed; detect first-run -> auto-expand once.

Maya Singh: OK. I'll draft an interaction spec: mini-row layout, anchored overlay rules, chip ARIA patterns, focus rules, localStorage toggle, and shortcut mapping. Will attach a small prototype.

Rui Park: I'll open runtime ticket #902 about KV retention on collapsed results and link here.

Caleb Ortiz: Small TODOs: [Maya] interaction spec + prototype, [Rui] runtime ticket, [Zoey] copy PR to standardize "Schema preview — inferred" and global "Run" label, [Caleb] accessibility test cases (focus order + aria-live).

A11yBot: Added TODOs to the project board and linked this thread.
